verses.pali: Āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ rādhaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Rādha went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “Pariññeyye ca, rādha, dhamme desessāmi pariññañca pariññātāviṁ puggalañca.
verses.english: “Rādha, I will teach you the things that should be completely understood, complete understanding, and the individual who has completely understood.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā rādho bhagavato paccassosi.

verses.english: “And what things should be completely understood?

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, pariññeyyo dhammo, vedanā pariññeyyo dhammo, saññā pariññeyyo dhammo, saṅkhārā pariññeyyo dhammo, viññāṇaṁ pariññeyyo dhammo.
verses.english: Form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness.
These are called the things that should be completely understood.

verses.pali: Yo kho, rādha, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo—
verses.english: The ending of greed, hate, and delusion.
And what is the individual who has completely understood?
It should be said: a perfected one,
the venerable of such and such name and clan.
This is called the individual who has completely understood.”
